item.title: Why winter cold spells are getting milder
item.description: The Beast from the East ravaged much of the U.K. and Europe in February and March 2018, bringing severe storms, snow showers and bitter winds. But as the climate changes, rising average temperatures will affect the severity of extremely cold weather like this. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: Mapping wildfire risk across the US, day by day
item.description: Wildfires can spread fastest when they tear through areas of dry vegetation. In contrast, vegetation that contains a lot of moisture can slow a wildfire's advance and give firefighting crews precious time to contain the blaze. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: Hurricane Helene deposited nearly one-fifth of annual microplastics at one North Carolina site
item.description: Rainfall from Hurricane Helene produced a short-term spike in microplastics at three sites in western North Carolina, with microplastic deposition three to 22 times higher than before the storm. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: 3065 reproducciones · 33 reacciones | Qué falló antes y después del terremoto que agravó la tragedia en Venezuela La devastación del doble sismo en Venezuela no fue solo provocada por la fuerza de la naturaleza. También fue el resultado de malas decisiones y demoras en la respuesta que multiplicaron el desastre, según numerosos expertos. Qué ocurrió durante las horas críticas y qué pasó después. Desde los edificios que no resistieron hasta la lenta llegada de maquinaria pesada; desde los equipos de rescate atrapados por la burocracia hasta las comunidades que quedaron solas entre los escombros; desde los errores que costaron vidas hasta la solidaridad de quienes las salvaron. Este reportaje es la radiografía de un terremoto que puso a prueba a un país entero, de las historias de valor de quienes se negaron a rendirse y de los fallos y las ausencias que marcaron esta tragedia. | DW Español

item.title: Coastal flooding occurs at predictable times, research reveals
item.description: Coastal flooding may seem unpredictable, a natural disaster that occurs randomly. But UCF researcher Ivan Haigh has found that recurrent coastal floods occur at highly predictable times. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: Scientists map the changing sounds of the Arctic to strengthen global monitoring
item.description: As Arctic sea ice retreats, new shipping routes, expanding resource development and growing geopolitical competition are transforming one of the world's least-monitored regions. Scientists at Los Alamos National Laboratory have established one of the first long-term acoustic baselines for the Arctic's underwater soundscape. This work strengthens the detection and interpretation of earthquakes, underwater and nearshore detonations, ship traffic and other events of national security interest. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: Hydrogen crosses, water stays: Palladium membrane enables ammonia synthesis using water
item.description: A South Korean research team has developed an environmentally friendly ammonia synthesis process that reduces carbon emissions using a membrane that selectively transports hydrogen. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: The Guardian view on a supersized El Niño: a natural phenomenon and human folly are a lethal combination | Editorial
item.description: Hundreds of thousands are expected to die, millions to go hungry. This is not just about weather patterns, but about injustice Some warnings are so grave that it is almost impossible to fully comprehend them. The descriptions of a super-sized, “Godzilla-level” El Niño already heating our planet would sound hyperbolic were they not issuing from eminent scientists. They say that the weather pattern, which occurs roughly every two to seven years, may be the strongest in at least a millennium. item.title: Francia: ¿pueden los empresarios salvar los bosques?
item.description: En Francia, algunos empresarios están comprando grandes extensiones de bosque para dejar que la naturaleza recupere su espacio. Su objetivo es impulsar la renaturalización, proteger la biodiversidad y contribuir a la lucha contra el cambio climático. Pero esta iniciativa plantea una pregunta: ¿puede la inversión privada convertirse en una herramienta eficaz para conservar los ecosistemas? Un reportaje de Renard y Valérie Dekimpe para France 24. item.description: Durante décadas, la humanidad ha estado buscando señales de radio que provienen de los exoplanetas que hay en todo el universo. El origen de estas ondas se ubica en el planeta β Pictoris b, un gigante gaseoso que cuenta con una masa que es entre 10 y 12 veces la de Júpiter, y que está situado a unos 63 o 64 años luz de nuestro planeta. item.title: In New York, 29 million discarded glass bottles were ground into concrete for JPMorgan headquarters
item.description: A groundbreaking skyscraper in Midtown Manhattan ingeniously incorporates 29 million recycled bottles as structural elements, tackling both environmental and construction hurdles. The project innovatively replaces Portland cement with ground-glass pozzolan, dramatically cutting down carbon emissions. Despite the ecological materials, engineers adhered to an expedited construction timeline, while the glass-infused concrete combats urban heat. This pioneering effort has sparked a broader adoption of ground-glass pozzolan in local infrastructure endeavors. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Minuto a minuto de la Asamblea General
item.description: Como cada septiembre, los líderes del mundo se disponen a hacer un respaso de una agenda internacional ocupada con temas priorarios desde hace años, como la cuestión de Palestina, la guerra de Ucrania, el cambio climático o la justicia social, y a la que se añaden nuevos asuntos como la guerra de Irán o la inteligencia artificial. item.title: Delaying cherry blossom to reduce frost damage
item.description: Climate change is causing many fruit trees to flower earlier, increasing their exposure to damaging late spring frosts. A study led by the University of Göttingen shows that the plant growth regulator ethephon can delay flowering in Kordia, a sweet cherry variety, potentially protecting blossoms and developing fruitlets from frost. The treatment did not significantly delay flowering in a second sweet cherry variety or two apple varieties, highlighting the importance of crop and cultivar selection. The results are published in BMC Plant Biology. Fuente: Phys.org.
